title: Compose and publish Remix Protocol: Stop-Start Funk variation
description: Compose and publish a syncopated 116 BPM stop-start funk break variation of Remix Protocol using syncopated kicks, ghost-snare rolls, abrupt 2-beat mutes, and funk chord movement.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Composed and auditioned Remix Protocol: Stop-Start Funk variation (116 BPM, Am) with funk blues harmonic movement (i7 -> iv7 -> i7 -> V7 iv7). Uses clustered funk syncopations, ghost-snare patterns, and dramatic full-mute stop-start edits leaving solo dry speech before snapping back. Published to cloud storage as scr_scores_Remix Protocol: Stop-Start Funk_apr.

right_now_summary: The 116 BPM stop-start funk variation was composed, auditioned, and published to cloud storage.
